title: Monthly revenue per customer, 2024
prompt: Finance wants monthly revenue per customer for 2024, to spot who's ramping up spend. Order_items start at one row per line item — what does a row need to represent once you've built what finance asked for?
population: Completed orders placed in 2024 and their order_items.
grain: Starts at one row per order item; ends at one row per customer per month.
metricDefinition: sum(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) per customer per month, for completed orders in 2024.
referenceSql: SELECT o.customer_id, date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.customer_id, date_trunc('month', o.order_date)
